questions.q:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.

Mrs Smith invited her friends and we to her son's birthday party.
questions.s:
Option 3 is the right answer. It has an error.

Key Points

  • Personal pronouns have two categories-- the subject pronouns--I, he, she, we, they. The object pronouns--me, him, her, us, them.
  • This means the subject pronouns are placed in the subject place before the verb and the object pronouns are placed in the object place after the verb.
  • 'We' is a subject pronoun. However, in the given sentence, it is placed in the object place which is incorrect.
  • So, 'We' should be replaced with an object pronoun 'us'. [ both first-person plural].

The correct sentence is--Mrs Smith invited her friends and us to her son's birthday party.

questions.q:
Everybody stared / when me / entered the / drawing room.

(SSC CGL Mains 07/03/2022 S1)
questions.s:
Correct Answer: when me

In the sentence, "when me" is incorrect because "me" is an objective pronoun used as the object of a verb or preposition. A subject pronoun ("I") is required since the pronoun is performing the action (entered the room).

Subject pronouns (I, he, she, we, they) are used when the pronoun is the subject of the verb.

Correct Sentence: Everybody stared when I entered the drawing room.

questions.q:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

She has been a member of this club since it’s formation
questions.s:
The correct answer is 'since it's formation'. 

  • The erroneous Part 'since it's formation' will be 'since its formation'.
  • It’s is a contraction of “it is” or “it has.”
  • Whereas, 'Its' is a possessive determiner we use to say that something belongs to or refers to something.
  • Here, in the given question possessive case that is 'its' should be used because it is talking about the formation of the club
     

Thus the correct sentence is: She has been a member of this club since its formation.
